name: The Raid
description: Seal-day in Emberbrook ends in a raid. Find the Seal Angels at the shrine.

prologue.text: Seal-day in Emberbrook. Bells ring over the festival, then the shrine's lanterns go out all at once. Unsealed raiders pour between the stalls. In the chaos, something wakes in your chest: a spark you have carried all your life.

stages.name: Seal-day
stages.description: Be in Emberbrook for the Seal-day festival.

stages.name: Find the Seal Angels
stages.description: Go to the shrine and answer the angels.

name: Four Lessons
description: The angels gave you a deck. Four raiders and a rival stand between you and the road.

epilogue.text: The rival grins at you. "Fine. The Seals chose you for now. Mossgate is where the Wardens keep their gates. I'll see you there." Their shouts fade down the road. Elder Wren's message is waiting at the shrine: take the village's Seal fragment to Mossgate.

stages.name: Beat the raiders
stages.description: Beat the four raiders and the rival in the shrine yard.

name: Set Out
description: Elder Wren sends you to Mossgate with the village's Seal fragment.

prologue.text: Elder Wren presses a warm stone into your hand. It is a fragment of the Seal that guards Emberbrook. Take it to Mossgate, where a Warden keeps the Seals.

epilogue.text: Mossgate's notice board is covered in posters. One of them is the Champion's open challenge.
